metadata.name: RescueRoute Real-World Food Recovery & Vehicle Dispatch Benchmark

standards_cited.authority: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS)
standards_cited.document: The 'Danger Zone' (40 °F - 140 °F) & Two-Hour Food Safety Rule
Section 3-501.16: Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food
Food Waste Landfill Diversion Emissions Factor (2.5 lbs CO2e/lb food)
Standard Vehicle Trunk & Payload Limits (Sedan ~14 cu.ft / SUV ~38 cu.ft)

results.title: Feeding America Standard Meal Calculation (60 lbs)
results.observation: Accurate: 50 meals provided, 150 lbs CO2e averted.
results.source: Feeding America FAQ (1.2 lbs/meal) & EPA WARM factor (2.5 lbs CO2e/lb)

results.title: Perishable Hot Food with 25 Minutes Remaining (Critical Alert)
results.observation: Correctly flagged CRITICAL alert at 25 minutes remaining.
results.source: USDA FSIS Two-Hour Safety Guideline

results.title: Chilled Dairy with 75 Minutes Remaining (Warning Alert)
results.observation: Correctly flagged WARNING alert at 75 minutes remaining.
results.source: USDA FSIS Two-Hour Safety Guideline

results.title: Bakery Bread 45 lbs (Compact Sedan Fit)
results.observation: Properly matched 45 lbs bakery bread to Compact Sedan (Capacity: 90 lbs).
results.source: Edmunds Compact Sedan Trunk Specs (< 90 lbs)

results.title: Wholesale Produce 130 lbs (Hatchback/CUV Required)
results.observation: Prevented compact sedan overload; assigned Hatchback/CUV for 130 lbs cargo.
results.source: Edmunds CUV Specifications (75-180 lbs)

results.title: Supermarket Pallet Dairy 240 lbs (SUV/Van Required)
results.observation: Assigned SUV/Van for 240 lbs bulk dairy crates.
results.source: Edmunds Minivan/SUV Specifications (180-400 lbs)

results.title: Multi-Stop Sequencing with Urgency Prioritization
results.observation: TSP algorithm sequenced Critical Perishable stop FIRST before normal run, respecting cold-chain limits.
results.source: USDA Cold-Chain Priority Rules: Critical perishables must be collected first

results.title: Haversine Distance Between SF Metro Nodes (Downtown to Campus)
results.observation: Haversine distance accurate: 0.6 miles between downtown nodes.
results.source: Great Circle / Haversine Distance Formula

results.title: Hot Food Borderline Temperature (141°F Safe)
results.observation: FDA compliance verified: 141°F for hot_holding evaluates to safe=true.
results.source: FDA Food Code: Hot holding must maintain >= 140°F

results.title: Hot Food Danger Zone Violation (138°F Unsafe)
results.observation: FDA compliance verified: 138°F for hot_holding evaluates to safe=false.
results.source: FDA Food Code: Hot holding below 140°F is in Danger Zone

results.title: Chilled Dairy Borderline Temperature (40°F Safe)
results.observation: FDA compliance verified: 40°F for chilled evaluates to safe=true.
results.source: FDA Food Code: Cold food must maintain <= 41°F

results.title: Chilled Dairy Danger Zone Violation (46°F Unsafe)
results.observation: FDA compliance verified: 46°F for chilled evaluates to safe=false.
results.source: FDA Food Code: Cold food above 41°F is in Danger Zone

results.title: Deterministic Cryptographic SHA-256 Receipt Generation
results.observation: Valid 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 cryptographic digest generated: ef707895d8faaa46...
results.source: NIST FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 Specification

results.title: Vehicle Capacity Overload (Sedan Assigned 250 lbs)
results.observation: Overload guard triggered: 250 lbs exceeds Sedan capacity (90 lbs) by 278%.
results.source: Compact Sedan Trunk Safety Margin (Max 90 lbs)

results.title: Already Expired Run (Minus 10 Minutes Left)
results.observation: Expired run caught: Displayed 'EXPIRED (Safety Window Exceeded)'.
results.source: System Safety Guard: Expired runs must display EXPIRED warning

results.title: Fractional Weight and Decimal Scale Input (114.6 lbs)
results.observation: Fractional weight 114.6 lbs parsed correctly to 95.5 meals.
results.source: Certified Digital Hanging Scale Outputs

results.title: Zero Weight Input (0 lbs)
results.observation: Validation correctly rejected non-positive weight (0 lbs).
results.source: IRC § 170(e)(3) Validation Rules: Donation cannot be 0 lbs

results.title: Negative Weight Input (-15 lbs)
results.observation: Validation correctly rejected non-positive weight (-15 lbs).
results.source: Data Integrity Rules

results.title: Missing Item Description (Empty String)
results.observation: Validation correctly rejected empty/whitespace title.
results.source: Donor Manifest Requirements

results.title: Special Characters & HTML Tag Injection in Loading Dock Notes
results.observation: Script tag sanitized: 'alert('dock_exploit') Dock 4B & West Gate'.
results.source: OWASP Input Validation Guideline
